verdict.rationale: Bolna documents connecting your own STT provider through Settings → Integrations, names supported providers such as Deepgram and Azure, and lets you configure multiple languages per agent with mid-call language switching, which covers provider and language control. Its quickstart shows transcripts can be fetched after a call. missing for 10: explicit evidence of real-time/streaming transcription to the developer, key-term or keyword boosting controls, STT model selection, accuracy evidence or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms

citations.quote: Every provider you can bring to Bolna — telephony, LLM, TTS, STT and tools — is connected from a single place in the dashboard: Settings → Integrations.
Bolna supports Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs, and more.
Add multiple languages, set a default, and write a dedicated prompt for each.
40+ languages including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Bengali with native accents — the agent detects and switches mid-call on its own.
place a call, and fetch the transcript in about five minutes.
